summary: Owned-set member reads avoid canonical claim ID enumeration without changing public claim provenance

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

compatibility.detail: Owned-set preview and resource/member reads internally reduce Fields and return only actual state, never a serialized SubjectStatus or fake empty claims vector. Their response shapes are unchanged. GET /v1/status remains Full; no omit_claims option is introduced. CLI subject show, inspect, successful non-verdict trace-wait output and all other shared single-subject status consumers retain full claims; bounded recent_claims output remains unchanged. No public output changes.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes; reverting restores full claim ID enumeration inside owned-set member reads.
